title: Sea Urchin Teeth Get Sharper the More They Wear Down

scenes.text: This animal's teeth get sharper as they wear down.
It's a sea urchin, and it has five teeth.
They scrape rocks and hard shells through millions of chewing cycles.
Scientists found the tip chips away in a controlled way, like sharpening a knife.
And the teeth keep growing for the animal's whole life.
Engineers want to copy it for tools that sharpen themselves.

description:
A sea urchin's five teeth stay sharp because wear itself sharpens them.
Researchers at Northwestern found that the teeth chip away in a controlled way, keeping the tip sharp, and keep growing for life. Engineers hope to copy the design for self-sharpening tools.
What would you build with a blade that never goes dull? Comment below.
first_comment: The five-jaw chewing structure is called Aristotle's lantern. Would you buy a knife that sharpens itself every time you use it?
